correctness.rationale: The proof was reconstructed from the beta-integral reduction. The upper inequality is certified for d=5..26 by exact rational intervals and for all real d>=27 by a lower bound whose algebraic resultant has no roots on the tail and is positive at 27. The lower inequality is automatic before the exact endpoint crossing at d=14, and thereafter follows from a quadratic Taylor majorant plus an exact resultant/Sturm certificate. The embedded verifier reconstructs these certificates and returns VERIFY_OK. The limiting chi-square step follows from Slutsky convergence and the cited strict Gamma theorem.
